verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Visa and Mastercard virtual and physical cards funded from balance accounts, using either a single pool of funds or per-card balances. That implies balance-funded (debit/prepaid-style) programs, but the docs never name card program types or show credit issuance, so the product looks closer to the single funded rail the story wants to avoid. Missing for 10: explicit debit vs prepaid program documentation, commercial credit programs, consumer credit programs, credit line/underwriting support, independent corroboration.
